decks.title: Vocabulary - Core
decks.description: 303 high-frequency SAT words, 87% attested in College Board's own question bank and published practice tests.

decks.title: Vocabulary - Advanced
decks.description: Harder words, near-synonym discrimination pairs, and common words used in their uncommon SAT senses.

decks.title: Transitions - Core
decks.description: Every transition College Board uses, grouped by the relationship it signals, each with an example sentence.

decks.title: Transitions - Advanced
decks.description: Full in-context questions with four options, plus why each distractor fails.

decks.title: Math Signals - Core
decks.description: 170 signal-to-method cards, Desmos first, grouped by question type and ordered easy to hard within each type.

decks.title: Math Signals - Advanced
decks.description: Classify-it-yourself questions with no type given, plus the harder content tier: circles, trig, tangency and symbolic work.
